items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
4 - 7 years of related experience.
Related experience examples include, but are not limited to: higher education, public sector, and unionized environments.
May work with external resources including temporary agencies, contract search and internet sourcing tools. (30% time)

Resolves a wide range of employment issues using skills as a seasoned, experienced employment professional with a full understanding of employment and recruiting practices and organization policies and procedures. (30% time)
Prioritizes work assignments, conducts research and data analysis and helps develop resulting recommendations on assigned projects. (15% time)

Reporting and Auditing: • Manage the auditing and compliance with limited hour appointment criteria for union representation and policy classifications. • Collaborate with UCR ITS and Campus HR Partners to ensure reporting is accurate and resolve issues as needed. • Advise on next steps to recruit for positions that are shifting in appointment type status. (10% time)
Provides tools and training necessary to support a decentralized employment process. (5% time)
Applies professional employment and staffing techniques and concepts in varied and diverse settings. (5% time)
Engages in networking and outreach related activities to build and assess qualified applicants as needed. (5% time)
Read/Comprehend: Constantly
Write: Constantly
Perform Calculations: Occasionally
Communicate Orally: Constantly
Reason & Analyze: Constantly
Sit: Constantly
Stand: Occasionally
Walk: Occasionally
Thorough knowledge of organizational policies and procedures; knowledge of functional area and understands how work may impact other areas.
Demonstrated knowledge and application of state and federal laws and regulations for background check and misconduct check.
Thorough knowledge of the recruitment, screening, interviewing and referral processes.
Knowledge of HR processes and forms and knows organizational and departmental principles and procedures.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills as well as those needed for conducting needs assessment, providing input on candidate selection and problem solving.
Demonstrated ability to conduct complex analyses and develop recommendations.
Highly skilled in public speaking with ability to speak effectively and articulately in front of a large audience.
Demonstrated abilities associated with problem identification; reasoning; ability to work with business units in developing ideas to solve staffing issues.
Works with other areas of human resources as it relates to the employment function.
Knowledge of employment law.
Ability to be a team player and excel in a decentralized hybrid working environment.
Demonstrates core leadership competencies, including emotional intelligence, active listening, conflict resolution, team motivation, and structured problem-solving.
Must be able to travel to local job fairs.
Must pass the DOJ/FBI background check.
